title: Backport: CVE-2026-33414 PowerShell path escape (stubber.go) — v5.6
body:
## Missing fix on v5.6: PowerShell path injection in `stubber.go`

While auditing stable branches I noticed `pkg/machine/hyperv/stubber.go` on `v5.6` still interpolates `imagePath.GetPath()` directly into the PowerShell command line in `resizeDisk`, the pre-fix pattern that CVE-2026-33414 addresses.

### Evidence

| signal | result |
| --- | --- |
| `git compare v5.6...571c842bd3` | `status=diverged, ahead=1393, behind=71` |
| `pkg/machine/hyperv/stubber.go` blob sha on `v5.6` | `a2116a69…` (matches pre-fix tree, no IMAGE_PATH env handling) |
| Title scan of last 100 commits on `v5.6` | no match for "powershell path escape" / `CVE-2026-33414` |

The upstream fix is the single-commit PR [containers/podman#24289](https://github.com/containers/podman/pull/24289) — commit [`571c842bd3`](https://github.com/containers/podman/commit/571c842bd3), `+2/-1` inside `resizeDisk`. It moves the path through an `IMAGE_PATH` environment variable so PowerShell doesn't reinterpret special characters in the user-controlled path.

### Suggested action

Cherry-pick `571c842bd3` onto `v5.6`. Sibling request for `v5.7` is [#28618](https://github.com/containers/podman/issues/28618). I assume `v5.6` and `v5.5` are still in the stable rotation; if either has been retired, please close.

```go
- resize := exec.Command("powershell", []string{"-command", fmt.Sprintf("Resize-VHD \"%s\" %d", imagePath.GetPath(), newSize.ToBytes())}...)
+ resize := exec.Command("powershell", "-command", fmt.Sprintf("Resize-VHD \"$ENV:IMAGE_PATH\" %d", newSize.ToBytes()))
+ resize.Env = append(os.Environ(), "IMAGE_PATH="+imagePath.GetPath())
```

*Filed as part of a sweep flagging missing security backports across stable branches. Not a maintainer — happy to be corrected if I've misread the branch state.*
